meta.purpose: Two mock organisations under one company, with deliberately DISTINCT, identifiable content so cross-tenant leakage is easy to detect in red-team tests.
meta.note: org_id is the isolation boundary (internal, never renamed). `name` is the DISPLAY name shown in the UI. distinct_markers are internal test fixtures, never shown, kept genuinely distinct between orgs — the red-team suite relies on one org's markers never appearing in another's results.
